title: Information of Greenovia 山地玫瑰概述

segments.t: 作者：Bjorn Malkmus-Hussein   @rareplants.de 翻译：Neooode_欧阳 as some Chinese customers recently had some questions concerning Greenovia species, we compiled some information. As it might be of interest to you as well, we would like to share it with all Chinese customers. 鉴于最近中国客户经常询问的关于山地玫瑰的问题，我们编译了一些信息。由于你们也可能会对它感兴趣，我们很乐意将它与所有中国客户分享。 The genus Greenovia within the family Crassulaceae consists of only 5 species (plus one variety) and is restricted to the Canary islands in the Atlantic ocean. The Canary islands belong to Spain and are seven islands offshore western Morocco in Northwestern Africa: 在景天科的大家庭中，Greenovia山地玫瑰属只有5个种类（加上一个变种），它们仅分布于大西洋加那利群岛。加那利群岛，属于西班牙，包含7个岛屿，靠近非洲西北部的摩洛哥西部海岸。

Greenovia aurea （俗称黄金山地，见@植栽译） Greenovia diplocycla（冷霜，见@植栽译） Greenovia aizoon（长生，见@植栽译） Greenovia aurea, Greenovia dodrantalis（玉瓮，见@植栽译） Greenovia diplocycla var. gigantea（传说中的鸡蛋玫瑰，其实应该叫鸵鸟蛋玫瑰，因为它可能长大到直径40cm！） The eastern islands Fuerteventura and Lanzarote are greatly influenced by the Sahara desert in Morocco. These two islands are very dry, so that no Greenovia species occurs on these two desert-like islands. The western islands receive more humidity (mostly in winter from the Atlantic ocean) and here one can find the following species: 东部岛群Fuerteventura（富埃特文图岛）和Lanzarote（兰萨罗特岛），受摩洛哥境内撒哈拉沙漠的影响很大，这两个岛屿非常干燥,以致没有山地玫瑰能在这两个荒凉的岛屿上生存。而西部岛群受大西洋暖湿气流影响(特别是冬天),在这里可以分别找到以下种类: El Hierro（耶罗岛）: Greenovia aurea （黄金山地） La Gomera（戈梅拉岛）: Greenovia diplocycla（冷霜）, Greenovia diplocycla var. gigantea（鸡蛋玫瑰） La Palma（帕尔马岛）: Greenovia aurea, Greenovia diplocycla Lanzarote（兰萨罗特岛）: -/- Gran Canaria（大加那利岛）: Greenovia aurea Fuerteventura（富埃特文图岛）: -/- Tenerife（特内里费岛）: Greenovia aizoon（长生）, Greenovia aurea, Greenovia dodrantalis（玉瓮）
Greenovia aurea (ex El Hierro) （黄金山地）
Greenovia diplocycla var. gigantea（鸡蛋玫瑰）

Greenovia dodrantalis（玉瓮） Greenovia aurea is the most widespread species and it has isolated populations on various islands (Gran Canaria, Tenerife, La Palma and El Hierro). There are only minor and rather insignificant differences in plants from these islands. However, plants on El Hierro grow in more sun-exposed spots than those which occur on Tenerife or on Gran Canaria and La Palma. The sunnier this species is grown, the more reddish leaves will be. However, plants from El Hierro will usually show more "red" than plants from Tenerife if grown under the same conditions in cultivation. 黄金山地（Greenovia aurea）是分布最广泛的品种，分布在各个孤立的岛屿(Gran Canaria大加那利岛, Tenerife特内里费岛, La Palma帕尔马岛,El Hierro耶罗岛)上，形成种群隔离。但各个岛屿上的植物间只有小到微不足道的差别。其中，相比Tenerife（特内里费岛）、Gran Canaria（大加那利岛）、La Palma（帕尔马岛），来自El Hierro（耶罗岛）的山地玫瑰生长环境中光照较多。这个品种成长期间光照越充足，会有越多的叶子变红。即使在相同的培养环境下，来自El Hierro（耶罗岛)的山地玫瑰通常会比来自Tenerife（特内里费岛）显得更红！ All Greenovia species are winter growing and summer dormant in nature. That means, that in our hot summers with no rains at all from April through September, plants will go dormant and close their leaves to cup-shape (Greenvia aizoon, Greenovia aurea and Greenovia dodrantalis) or even ball-like (leaves will completely close in Greenovia diplocycla var. gigantea). However, in cultivation with regular watering in summer, plants will not go completely dormant and will keep on growing. If you keep plants of Greenovia aurea rather dry in summer and in a very sunny spot, they will close their leaves and show a more reddish color. 事实上所有山地玫瑰都是冬型种，冬季生长，夏季休眠。这意味着，在炎热的夏天，从四月持续到九月，完全没有下雨，山地玫瑰会进入休眠并且叶子收拢成杯形，比如：Greenvia aizoon（长生）, Greenovia aurea（黄金山地） and Greenovia dodrantalis（玉瓮），甚至完全成球形，比如：Greenovia diplocycla var. gigantea。然而，夏天日常养护中依然正常给水，山地玫瑰将不会完全进入休眠而是保持生长中。如果你在夏季时对Greenovia aurea（黄金山地）严格控水并养在阳光明媚的地方，它们将会逐渐收拢叶子并变得越来越红。 In general, all Greenovia species grow in a more or less similar habitat in crevices of vertical rock walls and they are mostly winter growing and summer dormant plants. In nature seeds will germinate with the first autumn rains and lower overall temperatures. In some years An optimal temperature range for sowing would be 20°C at day and some 15°C at night. Higher temperatures may impede or significantly prolong germination. 一般来说，所有长在悬崖峭壁上的山地玫瑰，其栖息地环境都或多或少相类似，大多都是冬型种。在自然环境中，山地玫瑰种子会在第一场秋雨中发芽，低于全年整体温度。经过几年的观察，最佳播种温度范围在白天20°C，晚上15°C，较高的温度会妨碍或者明显延长发芽时间。 We do not collect Greenovia seeds every year, so it may happen that a sold out species willl not become available again in the next two years. This year seeds from Greenovia aurea (ex Tenerife) will become available by the end of June. It is still not quite sure if we will collect seeds from this species on the islands of El Hierro and Gran Canaria as well. If we do so, seeds will become available again around August this year. 我们并不是每年都收集山地玫瑰种子，所有有时会出现，某些品种今年卖光了，在接下来的两年也依然没有货。来自Tenerife（特内里费岛）的Greenovia aurea（黄金山地）种子将在今年六月底上架。至于我们是否会收集这个品种来自El Hierro （耶罗岛）and Gran Canaria（大加那利岛）的种子，目前尚不清楚。如果我们有收集，那么这个品种在今年8月份会再次上架。
